title: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
title_zh: 基于原生3D扩散的运动恢复结构

paragraphs.en: Recovering an object’s 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM , which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for 4 4 uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by 3.2 3.2 – 4.5 4.5 dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by 2.8 2.8 – 3.8 × 3.8\times over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over 96 % 96\% Acc@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/ .
paragraphs.zh: 从少量未标定视角中恢复物体的三维结构与相机运动是计算机视觉中的一个基础问题。 经典的运动恢复结构方法能恢复与输入图像一致的三维几何，但无法恢复未见的区域；原生生成方法可以生成看似合理的三维物体，但这些物体与输入图像相关却不一定忠实于输入图像。 简单地将重建与生成拼接的方法会让误差在两个阶段之间级联累积，而不是生成一个既符合分布又与输入一致的三维物体。 我们提出 GenSfM，它将基于图像的三维重建与原生三维扩散模型相融合。 特别地，我们使用一个多模态扩散 Transformer，在共享自注意力机制下对形状潜变量和各视角的位姿潜变量进行联合去噪，将生成的几何锚定在所观测的视角上，同时利用物体级先验来推断未被观测的区域。 一种紧凑的三维原生 UV 体积令牌化方法在视角增加时保持联合序列的规模较小，并且一个位姿感知阶段通过在恢复出的相机位姿处采样逐体素图像特征来精修几何与纹理。 在 Toys4k 和 GSO 数据集上，对于 4 4 个未标定视角，GenSfM 相比一个强大的原生三维生成基线，将新视角 PSNR 提升了 3.2 3.2 – 4.5 4.5 dB，并将中值 Chamfer 距离降低了 2.8 2.8 – 3.8 × 3.8\times，同时无需任何外部位姿估计骨干网络、事后优化或已知内参，就能以超过 96 % 96\% 的 Acc@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} 恢复输入视角的位姿。 项目主页：https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/ 。

paragraphs.en: Recovering 3D structure and camera motion from images is a foundational problem in computer vision. Classical Structure-from-Motion and Multi-View Stereo pipelines Schönberger and Frahm (2016) ; Schönberger et al. (2016) ; Furukawa and Ponce (2009) estimate camera poses from multi-view correspondences and reconstruct geometry through photometric or geometric consistency, often regularized by hand-crafted priors. While effective when input views provide sufficient texture, overlap, and coverage, this geometric paradigm becomes brittle in sparse object-centric settings, where only a few uncalibrated views are available and large object regions go unrecovered.
paragraphs.zh: 从图像中恢复三维结构与相机运动是计算机视觉中的一个基础问题。 经典的运动恢复结构与多视图立体流程 Schönberger and Frahm (2016) ; Schönberger et al. (2016) ; Furukawa and Ponce (2009) 从多视图对应关系中估计相机位姿，并通过光度或几何一致性重建几何，通常由手工设计的先验进行正则化。 尽管当输入视图提供足够的纹理、重叠和覆盖时该方法行之有效，但这种几何范式在稀疏的以物体为中心的场景中变得脆弱——此时仅有少量未标定的视图可用，且物体的许多区域无法得到恢复。

paragraphs.en: Such settings are common in practice, from robotic manipulation to AR capture and content-creation pipelines, all of which need a holistic 3D representation to reason about occluded surfaces and contact regions. Sparse-view 3D object recovery therefore requires more than triangulating visible evidence: it must infer a complete 3D explanation that is both consistent with the input images and plausible as an object, jointly answering what the object is and where each view was taken from.
paragraphs.zh: 这类设置在实践中很常见，从机器人操作到 AR 采集与内容创作流程，所有这些都需要一个整体的 3D 表示来推理被遮挡的表面和接触区域。 因此，稀疏视角的 3D 物体恢复不仅仅是通过对可见证据进行三角化：它必须推断出一个完整的 3D 解释，该解释既要与输入图像保持一致，又要作为一个物体而言是合理的，同时回答物体是什么以及每个视角是从哪里拍摄的。

paragraphs.en: Recent learning-based methods relax the texture and overlap assumptions of classical pipelines by introducing large-scale data-driven priors. Feed-forward reconstructors Wang et al. (2024) ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) predict camera parameters and pixel-aligned 3D representations jointly, while pose-centric works Zhang et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Sinha et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) estimate relative camera motion under limited overlap and pose ambiguity. Both threads remain primarily observation-driven: they recover what the input views support but do not explicitly model the distribution of complete object shapes, leaving outputs incomplete in unobserved regions when input coverage is poor.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来的基于学习的方法通过引入大规模数据驱动的先验，放松了经典流程对纹理和重叠的假设。 前馈式重建器 Wang et al. (2024) ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) 联合预测相机参数和像素对齐的三维表示，而以位姿为核心的工作 Zhang et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Sinha et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) 则在有限重叠和位姿歧义条件下估计相对相机运动。 这两类方法都主要以观测为驱动：它们恢复输入视图所支持的内容，但并未显式建模完整物体形状的分布，因此当输入覆盖不足时，输出在未观测区域会不完整。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work introduces generative priors learned from large-scale 3D datasets Deitke et al. (2023) into sparse reconstruction. View-based generative SfM Zhao et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) ; Xu et al. (2024a) ; Zhao and Tulsiani (2024) casts structure and motion as a generative problem in view space, while reconstruct-then-generate pipelines Ardelean et al. (2025) ; Huang et al. (2026) ; Chang et al. (2025) ; Team et al. (2025) ; Siddiqui et al. (2026) pair feed-forward reconstructors with native 3D generators Tochilkin et al. (2024) ; Xiang et al. (2025) ; Zhao et al. (2025b) . The latter family in particular has shown that 3D generative priors can complete hidden geometry that observation-driven methods cannot. These systems remain cascaded: an external module predicts poses or image-aligned representations and the 3D generator only completes the result, propagating errors across stages and preventing joint optimization of a single 3D hypothesis that explains all input views.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we invert this pipeline: instead of using a generative prior to complete the output of a feed-forward reconstructor, we treat the 3D generative prior itself as the primary reasoning mechanism for sparse-view reconstruction. We propose GenSfM , an end-to-end framework that formulates joint recovery of complete object structure and per-view camera motion as a single conditional inference problem in a native 3D diffusion model, as shown in Fig. 1 . The diffusion prior operates directly on a native 3D representation throughout inference, simultaneously denoising shape and per-view pose under joint self-attention. This grounds the generated object in the observed views while using object-level regularities to infer unobserved geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们反转了这一流程：不是使用生成先验来补全前馈重建器的输出，而是将三维生成先验本身作为稀疏视角重建的主要推理机制。 我们提出 GenSfM，这是一个端到端框架，如图 1 所示，它将完整物体结构与逐视角相机运动的联合恢复表述为原生三维扩散模型中的单一条件推理问题。 该扩散先验在整个推理过程中直接作用于原生三维表示，在联合自注意力下同时对形状和逐视角位姿进行去噪。 这使得生成的物体扎根于观测到的视角，同时利用物体级别的规律性来推断未被观测到的几何结构。

paragraphs.en: Realizing this formulation requires a single diffusion transformer that jointly denoises a shared 3D shape with a per-view pose latent bound to its input image, while keeping the per-view pose-token overhead small as views are added. We adopt CUPID ’s Huang et al. (2025) 3D-native UV-volume pose tokenization, but compress each view’s pose latent to a compact token grid, since the dense volume over-parameterizes a low-DoF perspective projection. A learned view embedding tags each view’s pose latent and image tokens, binding pose to its source image. Since neither stream natively carries cross-view information, we prepend a small set of register tokens to the shape stream as a shared channel for all views to communicate through self-attention.
paragraphs.zh: 要实现这一表述，需要一个单一的扩散Transformer，它对共享的3D形状进行联合去噪，同时为每个视角去噪一个绑定到其输入图像的每视角位姿潜在表示，并且在增加视角时保持每视角位姿token的开销较小。 我们采用CUPID的Huang et al. (2025) 的3D原生UV体积位姿token化方案，但将每个视角的位姿潜在表示压缩为紧凑的token网格，因为稠密体积对低自由度的透视投影来说是过度参数化的。 一个可学习的视角嵌入会标记每个视角的位姿潜在表示和图像token，从而将位姿绑定到其源图像。 由于两条流本身都不携带跨视角信息，我们在形状流前加入一小组寄存器token，作为所有视角通过自注意力机制进行通信的共享通道。

paragraphs.en: We propose GenSfM , a joint native-3D architecture that recasts a diffusion model from a post-hoc completion module into the primary inference mechanism for joint sparse-view structure and motion recovery, eliminating any external feed-forward reconstruction backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 GenSfM，一种联合原生 3D 架构，它将扩散模型从事后补全模块转变为联合稀疏视角结构与运动恢复的主要推理机制，从而无需任何外部前馈重建主干网络。

paragraphs.en: A 3D-native multi-view pose tokenization that places per-view UV-volume pose latents and the shape latent in a single multi-modal sequence, jointly denoised by a diffusion transformer under shared self-attention.
paragraphs.zh: 一种 3D 原生的多视角姿态标记化方法，将每个视角的 UV 体积姿态潜变量与形状潜变量置于同一个多模态序列中，由扩散 Transformer 在共享自注意力机制下进行联合去噪。

paragraphs.en: A pose-aware fine stage that, with cameras recovered from the coarse stage, anchors semantic and texture features at every active voxel and averages them across views, sharpening surface detail beyond global, pose-agnostic conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 一个位姿感知的精细阶段，利用从粗略阶段恢复的相机，在每个活跃体素处锚定语义与纹理特征，并在多个视角间取平均，使表面细节的锐利程度超越全局的、与位姿无关的调节。

paragraphs.en: Sparse-view object reconstruction must jointly answer two coupled questions: what is the 3D object, and where was each view taken from? What requires both visible and hidden object structure, while where requires the camera motion relating the input views. Existing methods typically excel on one side or address the two with separate models stacked in series (Tab. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 稀疏视角物体重建必须同时回答两个相互耦合的问题：三维物体是什么，以及每个视角是从哪里拍摄的？ 「是什么」需要同时利用可见与被遮挡的物体结构，而「在哪里」则需要关联输入视角的相机运动。 现有方法通常只在其中一方面表现出色，或者用串联堆叠的两个独立模型来分别处理这两个问题（表 1）。

(2025) : TRELLIS run as a single-image generator on each input view independently, with the mean over the four outputs reported; (b) TRELLIS -M Xiang et al. (2025) : TRELLIS with multi-view input in stochastic mode, where each denoising step is conditioned on one randomly chosen input view; (c) SAM 3D Team et al. (2025) : a single-image-to-3D generator run once per input view, with the mean over the four outputs reported; (d) FreeSplatter Xu et al. paragraphs.en: We ablate each design choice on Toys4k in Tab. 5 , with rows added cumulatively. In Stage 1, full cross-attention enables cross-view information sharing and improves all metrics; visual feature conditioning sharpens photometric fidelity and pose accuracy with only marginal geometry gains, suggesting appearance cues primarily help rendering and pose grounding; shared register tokens aggregate global information and contribute most to pose accuracy and the strict F@ ​ .01 \text{F@}.01 threshold. paragraphs.en: We presented GenSfM , which recasts a native 3D diffusion model as the primary inference mechanism for sparse-view object reconstruction, jointly denoising shape and per-view camera poses in a single multi-modal diffusion transformer. Three choices keep the formulation tractable: a UV-volume pose latent compressed to a compact token grid, a unified multi-modal sequence that places shape and per-view pose tokens in a single self-attention, and a pose-aware fine stage that conditions each voxel on features sampled at its pose-aligned image projection. On Toys4k and GSO, GenSfM outperforms feed-forward, 3D-generation, and pose-prediction baselines on photometric, geometric, and pose metrics simultaneously, recovering both extrinsics and intrinsics to high accuracy without any external pose estimator or post-hoc optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GenSfM，它将原生 3D 扩散模型重新构建为稀疏视角物体重建的主要推理机制，在单个多模态扩散 Transformer 中联合去噪形状与每个视角的相机位姿。 三个设计选择使该公式保持可处理性：将位姿潜变量压缩为紧凑令牌网格的 UV 体积表示、将形状与逐视角位姿令牌置于单一自注意力中的统一多模态序列，以及位姿感知的精细阶段——该阶段以在体素位姿对齐的图像投影处采样的特征来条件化每个体素。 在 Toys4k 和 GSO 数据集上，GenSfM 在光度、几何与位姿指标上同时超越前馈式、3D 生成与位姿预测基线，在无需任何外部位姿估计器或事后优化的情况下，以高精度恢复外参与内参。

paragraphs.en: This protocol applies to feed-forward reconstruction methods (LucidFusion, FreeSplatter, ReconViaGen), which already place geometry in a noisy estimate of the input-camera frame. For each input view, we back-project the per-pixel predicted depth at the predicted camera into 3D, alpha-mask the result, randomly subsample to at most 50K points per view, and pair it with the GT pointmap obtained by back-projecting GT depth at the GT camera. Stacking the per-view pairs with equal aggregate weight per view yields one set of 3D-to-3D correspondences per object, which we fit with a closed-form Umeyama similarity ( Umeyama, 2002 ) . The resulting transform is applied once to the full predicted 3D before all photometric and geometric evaluation; we log the per-object LSQ residual as an alignment-fidelity diagnostic. Note that this protocol exercises both halves of feed-forward reconstruction: the matched correspondences require the predicted geometry to align with the predicted cameras, so a method with weak geometry, weak pose recovery, or any mismatch between the two will produce noisy correspondences and a loose Umeyama fit, inflating all downstream metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 本协议适用于前馈式重建方法（LucidFusion、FreeSplatter、ReconViaGen），这些方法已经将几何放置在输入相机坐标系的含噪估计中。 对于每个输入视图，我们在预测相机处将逐像素预测深度反投影到三维空间，对结果进行 alpha 掩膜处理，随机下采样至每个视图至多 5 万个点，并将其与在 GT 相机处对 GT 深度反投影得到的 GT 点图配对。 将各视图的配对按每视图等聚合权重堆叠，即可得到每个物体的一组三维到三维对应关系，我们用闭式 Umeyama 相似变换（Umeyama, 2002）对其进行拟合。 所得变换在所有光度与几何评估之前一次性应用于完整的预测三维结果；我们记录每个物体的最小二乘残差作为对齐保真度的诊断指标。 请注意，本协议同时检验了前馈式重建的两个部分：匹配的对应关系要求预测几何与预测相机相互对齐，因此几何较弱、位姿恢复较弱或两者之间存在任何不一致的方法都会产生含噪的对应关系和松散的 Umeyama 拟合，从而抬高所有下游指标。

paragraphs.en: Different pose-predicting baselines fix their world frame in different ways (some anchor to the first input view, some to an internal canonical frame, others through their own internal similarity fit), so absolute predicted extrinsics cannot be directly compared to GT extrinsics. To bypass this gauge ambiguity entirely, all metrics in Table 4 are computed on unordered pairs of input views: for each pair, the relative pose between the two views cancels any global rotation, translation, and scale that affects all views jointly, leaving only the camera geometry intrinsic to the pair. We adopt this pairwise form uniformly for both rotation and translation rather than anchoring to one reference view, which would entangle every error with the chosen anchor. For each object, we average each metric over the N ⁡ ( N − 1 ) / 2 N(N{-}1)/2 unordered pairs and then average across objects. Relative Rotation Error (RRE) is the geodesic angle (in degrees) between the predicted and GT relative rotations of the pair; Acc.@ 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} / Acc.@ 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} is the fraction of pairs whose RRE falls below the corresponding threshold; Relative Translation Error (RTE) is the angular error (in degrees) between the predicted and GT relative-translation directions, an angular form chosen because absolute translation magnitude is itself gauge-dependent (a global similarity scale can be reabsorbed by any consistent rescaling of all camera centers); and Field-of-View Error (RFOV) is the mean absolute difference (in degrees) between predicted and GT FOV, computed directly on intrinsics without any pose alignment, since intrinsics are independent of the world frame. To score baselines with a coarse front/back chirality ambiguity on geometric correctness rather than chirality alone, all angular metrics (RRE, Acc.@ { 5 ∘ , 15 ∘ } \{5^{\circ},15^{\circ}\} , RTE) are read off after collapsing R pred ​ R gt ⊤ R_{\text{pred}}R_{\text{gt}}^{\top} under the diag ⁡ ( ± 1 , ± 1 , − 1 ) \mathrm{diag}(\pm 1,\pm 1,-1) sign-flip equivalence class. The same rule is applied uniformly to all methods, including ours, to compare geometric recovery under a shared front/back equivalence. Chirality remains relevant for camera-dependent applications, so we explicitly note that this metric does not assess that failure mode.

sents.en: To bypass this gauge ambiguity entirely, all metrics in Table 4 are computed on unordered pairs of input views: for each pair, the relative pose between the two views cancels any global rotation, translation, and scale that affects all views jointly, leaving only the camera geometry intrinsic to the pair.

paragraphs.en: The pose VAE is a 3D-convolutional encoder–decoder over a 64 3 64^{3} voxel grid with a deliberately aggressive bottleneck: four 2 × 2{\times} spatial downsamples compress the input into a 4 3 4^{3} token grid with 8 8 channels per token. This compression is feasible because each per-voxel target is a smooth function of voxel position and a low-DoF camera, so the latent does not need to absorb high-frequency content. Per voxel the encoder receives three input channels (a binary in-frustum indicator plus the two pixel coordinates obtained by projecting the voxel center under the input camera), and the decoder emits the same three channels through a classification head (visibility mask) and a regression head (pixel UV).
paragraphs.zh: 位姿VAE是一个作用在64³体素网格上的3D卷积编码器–解码器，带有一个刻意设置得很激进、压缩率极高的瓶颈：四次2×2空间下采样将输入压缩为一个4³的token网格，每个token有8个通道。 这种压缩之所以可行，是因为每个逐体素目标是体素位置和一个低自由度相机的平滑函数，因此潜在表示不需要吸收高频内容。 逐体素地，编码器接收三个输入通道（一个二值的视锥内指示器，以及通过输入相机投影体素中心得到的两个像素坐标），解码器则通过一个分类头（可见性掩码）和一个回归头（像素UV）输出同样的三个通道。

paragraphs.en: Each view is encoded by two complementary streams that fuse into a single per-view token sequence for the coarse DiT to cross-attend to. A frozen DINOv2-L/14 with registers at 518 × 518 518{\times}518 produces 1374 1374 tokens per view (CLS + 4 registers + a 37 × 37 37{\times}37 patch grid) at 1024 1024 channels, supplying object-level semantics. In parallel, a lightweight 4-level CNN at 296 × 296 296{\times}296 ( 5 × 5 5{\times}5 convolutions, strides { 1 , 2 , 2 , 2 } \{1,2,2,2\} , output channels [ 6 , 6 , 6 , 8 ] [6,6,6,8] ) is patchified down to the same 37 × 37 37{\times}37 grid, with per-token contributions [ 384 , 96 , 24 , 8 ] [384,96,24,8] channel-concatenating into a 512 512 -dim local-texture feature. We append the 512 512 local channels onto the 1024 1024 semantic channels at every patch token (non-patch tokens zero-pad on the local side), giving a uniform per-token width of 1536 1536 and a cross-attention key/value of length N × 1374 N\times 1374 . The two streams are deliberately complementary: semantic anchors pose to image content, while local texture restores the pixel-faithful appearance cues the semantic encoder has discarded, letting cross-attention recover accurate cameras without polluting the joint self-attention with raw image tokens.

sents.en: The two streams are deliberately complementary: semantic anchors pose to image content, while local texture restores the pixel-faithful appearance cues the semantic encoder has discarded, letting cross-attention recover accurate cameras without polluting the joint self-attention with raw image tokens.

paragraphs.en: The fine stage refines up to L ≤ 32,768 L\leq 32{,}768 active voxels at 64 3 64^{3} under the cameras already recovered by the coarse stage. Cross-attending every voxel to thousands of image tokens per view is intractable, so we replace cross-attention with per-voxel pixel-aligned feature sampling: each voxel projects to 𝐮 j , i \mathbf{u}_{j,i} in view i i under the predicted camera, and visual features are bilinearly sampled at that pixel. This keeps fine-stage cost proportional to active voxels rather than view tokens, while the multi-scale taps let each voxel combine coarse contour cues with fine local texture without inflating the per-voxel width.

paragraphs.en: The coarse stage is fine-tuned for 1 1 M steps on 8 8 H200 GPUs at global batch size 64 64 ( 8 8 per GPU, split into two gradient-accumulation microbatches), initialized from a prior single-view coarse-stage checkpoint of ours (itself from the pretrained TRELLIS -image-large SS DiT). We use AdamW (lr 10 − 4 10^{-4} , no weight decay), CFG dropout 0.1 0.1 , the same cosine schedule and EMA as above, and timesteps drawn from a logit-normal distribution with mean 1.0 1.0 and std 1.0 1.0 ( σ min = 10 − 5 \sigma_{\min}{=}10^{-5} ). At each step we randomly choose between two timestep-coupling modes: with probability 0.8 0.8 , the shape stream and all pose streams share a single timestep; with probability 0.2 0.2 , each stream draws an independent timestep. The shared mode dominates so the model stays well-calibrated to the synchronized inference schedule, while the per-pose mode supplies enough timestep diversity that the per-modality AdaLN modulation actually learns to handle independent noise levels.

sents.zh: 随后，我们通过姿态 VAE 解码每个视角的姿态潜变量，并利用公式 2 的 DLT 求解恢复 𝐏 i ∗ \mathbf{P}_{i}^{*}。

sents.en: The fine stage runs a 25 25 -step flow-Euler sampler with sequential multi-view fusion at CFG strength 3.0 3.0 on the same [ 0.5 , 1.0 ] [0.5,1.0] interval and rescale factor, conditioned on the recovered cameras and on the per-voxel pose-sampled features of Eq. 7 .
sents.zh: 细阶段在 CFG 强度为 3.0 3.0 的条件下，于同一 [ 0.5 , 1.0 ] [0.5,1.0] 区间和相同的重缩放因子上，运行 25 25 步的 flow-Euler 采样器并进行序贯多视角融合，其条件为恢复出的相机以及公式 7 的逐体素姿态采样特征。

paragraphs.en: GenSfM produces a 3D representation of an object from a few uncalibrated images, jointly recovering shape and camera. The most direct positive applications are in robotics (object-level scene understanding from a small number of viewpoints), augmented and virtual reality (capturing personal items as 3D assets for placement in virtual environments), and content creation (3D meshes from reference photos as a starting point for downstream editing). Joint recovery of camera intrinsics and extrinsics with shape removes the calibration friction that has limited deployment of feed-forward reconstruction methods in casually-captured settings.
paragraphs.zh: GenSfM 能从少量未标定图像中生成物体的三维表示，同时恢复形状与相机参数。 最直接的正向应用包括机器人技术（从少量视角实现物体级场景理解）、增强现实与虚拟现实（将个人物品捕获为三维资产并放置到虚拟环境中），以及内容创作（由参考照片生成三维网格，作为后续编辑的起点）。 将相机内参与外参和形状进行联合恢复，消除了标定上的阻碍——正是这一阻碍限制了前馈式重建方法在随意拍摄场景中的部署。

paragraphs.en: The negative considerations are those shared with image-conditioned 3D generation more broadly: the resulting 3D models could be used to fabricate convincing 3D content of real-world objects, including objects belonging to others, without their consent; coupled with downstream rendering pipelines, this could enable image-only digital reproduction at a scale that traditional photogrammetry has not previously allowed. The model is trained only on common, non-sensitive object categories from public 3D-asset datasets, and recovery quality degrades on out-of-distribution categories, which provides a partial natural mitigation. Released model checkpoints will carry an attribution requirement and an acceptable-use note as the safeguard accompanying our open release.
paragraphs.zh: 负面考量与更广义的图像条件 3D 生成所面临的问题一致：生成的 3D 模型可能被用于在未经他人同意的情况下，伪造真实世界物体（包括属于他人的物体）的逼真 3D 内容；结合下游渲染管线，这可能使仅凭图像进行数字化复制成为可能，其规模是传统摄影测量法此前无法实现的。 该模型仅在来自公开 3D 资产数据集的常见、非敏感物体类别上训练，且对分布外类别的重建质量会下降，这提供了一定的天然缓解。 发布的模型检查点将附带署名要求与可接受使用说明，作为我们开源发布所配套的安全保障。
